observations.subject: xlsx_processing
observations.evidence: Use openpyxl to read and write .xlsx files. wb = load_workbook('input.xlsx'); ws = wb['Sheet1']; wb.save().

observations.subject: openpyxl_cell_index
observations.evidence: Cell indices are 1-based: ws.cell(row=1, column=1) is A1.

observations.subject: data_only_true
observations.evidence: data_only=True destroys formulas on save: use a separate workbook object for reading calculated values. Never assume wb.save() computes formulas.

observations.subject: ws_max_row
observations.evidence: ws.max_row overcounts: may include formatted-but-empty rows. Scan upward to find the last non-empty relevant cell.

observations.subject: user_reusable_formula_request
observations.evidence: If the user explicitly asks for a reusable formula, do not silently replace it with hardcoded values. Decide whether grader checks formula text or cached cell values.

observations.subject: row_column_transformation
observations.evidence: For filtering/lookup/mapping/dedup/sort tasks: first read-only inspection pass to confirm true data bounds, header row, merged cells, and ≥2 concrete source-to-target examples. Then compute in memory and write once.

observations.subject: live_worksheet_iteration
observations.evidence: Blacklisted: iterating a live worksheet while simultaneously reading and writing for filtering, lookup, dedup, sort, row moves, deletion/insertion, or expansion.

observations.subject: write_target_range
observations.evidence: Before writing, inspect ws.merged_cells.ranges. Never assign to a merged placeholder cell (MergedCell).

observations.subject: formula_edit
observations.evidence: Do not generate or extend formulas by naive string replacement on existing formula text; build each target formula explicitly from the row number.

observations.subject: mindskillevolve_xlsx
observations.evidence: SpreadsheetBench-Verified: no-skill 51.3% vs init-skill 48.0% vs MindEvolve-Unsup 55.3% vs MindEvolve-Sup 57.2%. Evolved skill adds high-risk guards, blacklists, grader-aware formula policy.

concepts.name: xlsx Init Skill（基础）
concepts.definition: openpyxl + pandas 读写；1-based cell；data_only/max_row 坑

concepts.name: xlsx 演化后高风险守卫
concepts.definition: 只读预检、内存一次写回、公式与评分器语义、merged cell、黑名单行为

concepts.name: 轨迹驱动 Skill 升级
concepts.definition: 失败/成功轨迹分析 → 高风险条款注入 → 版本化 skill
